text:
julia-cs: Customer reported ToolCall failing with 400 schema validation. They say it started after a recent SDK change. payload attached.
sarah-support: can you paste the failing payload and error?
alex-eng: pinging to triage — any stack traces or full validator error?
sarah-support: error from gateway: `400 Bad Request` -> `additionalProperties: 'promo_field' not allowed; billing_profile: expected object but got null; amount: expected integer`
julia-cs: customer payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "customer_id": 98765,
  "billing_profile": null,
  "amount": "12.50",
  "promo_field": "WELCOME10",
  "items": [{"sku": "S-1", "qty": 1}]
}
```
ben-platform: interesting — promo_field is unknown and billing_profile null is explicit. our func schema requires billing_profile object and `additionalProperties: false`.
sarah-support: customer says older calls worked; they suspect SDK now sends promo_field from UI.
alex-eng: repro steps from my sandbox: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d @payload.json` -> validator rejects at top-level due to promo_field first.
schema-bot: validator log: `ValidationError: Additional properties are not allowed ('promo_field' was unexpected) at /`
sarah-support: can we relax additionalProperties or coerce? customer is blocked (payment flow).
alex-eng: quick triage options: 1) accept additionalProperties at top-level (risk: silent typos), 2) whitelist promo_field in schema (safer), 3) return a more explicit error telling client to move promo_field under billing_profile.metadata.
ben-platform: short-term: whitelist `promo_field` and accept numeric strings for amount by coercing to number before validation. then issue patch to proper schema in follow-up.
sarah-support: customer ok with temporary workaround if it gets them unblocked.
alex-eng: putting up patch to relax validator and add coercion now, will deploy to staging -> canary. command: `git revert --no-verify && git apply patch` :grimacing: (kidding). real patch in PR #8421.
sarah-support: assign to @alex-eng to push canary and confirm with customer.
[20 minutes later]
alex-eng: canary deployed to eu-west-1, relaxed schema for promo_field and allow coercion of numeric strings for `amount`. running internal regression.
sarah-support: reached out to customer, they tested and reported success: service returns 200 and tool executes. :tada:
julia-cs: filing follow-up item with product to update schema docs and recommend placement for promo codes. also tracking analytics to see frequency of unknown top-level keys.
ben-platform: long-term: propose schema change to allow `billing_profile: null` only in migration window, but prefer explicit object. will open RFC.
sarah-support: closing thread once PR merges and docs update. thanks team. :heart:
